chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'It is from the understanding (fiqh) of the man that he seeks out a place for his urination.'

key_terms.فِقْهِ: Understanding or deep comprehension of religious matters, here applied to practical etiquette.
key_terms.يَرْتَادَ: To seek out, look for, or prepare a specific place.

ai.seo_question: What does it mean for a man to have 'fiqh' regarding urination according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In Shia scholarship, this hadith from Al-Kafi expands the concept of *fiqh* beyond legal rulings to include *adab* (etiquette), illustrating that true religious knowledge encompasses the subtle details of daily hygiene and social conduct. It underscores the principle that piety is manifested in mindful attention to cleanliness and avoiding public nuisance, a key aspect of the Imams' teachings on practical jurisprudence.
